relations.rationale: The existence of three teams is unrelated to whether everyone reassembled by midmorning.
The number of teams has no bearing on relative ages of Otto and Ivo.
Everyone reassembling near the visitor center sets up the opportunity for them to compare notes, supporting that they were doing so.
Everyone reassembling together provides opportunity for sharing water, mildly supporting that activity.
Comparing notes on birds is a separate activity from sharing water sips, neither implying nor precluding the other, though both fit a social gathering.
Comparing bird notes has no bearing on relative ages of Otto and Pia.
Everyone comparing notes on species seen is consistent with there being a ranking, supporting that Uma could rank highest.
Comparing notes on birds seen supports the idea that Uma might recount a specific bird sighting like the kingfisher.
Otto being younger than Pia does not determine his relative age to Ivo.
Uma ranking highest in species count is consistent with her having spotted many birds, supporting that she recounted seeing a kingfisher.
